triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size S.
Rationale: Change Owner is shipped, and its queue tab leaves out a class of assignment target that ADR-0142 makes first-class and every other queue picker offers. That is a shipped capability that is incomplete, so it is a Bug. It sits in the console dialog that #36395 already routes as `area:ux`, so it takes the UX rule: it is not hit by every user every time, so p2, and UX has no p3. Reach is unmeasured, as the body says.
